title: Mastery of Ingenuity
summary: Defeat the Master of Ingenuity while reflection and pet pressure limit easy damage.
overview: Defeat the Master of Ingenuity while reflection and pet pressure limit easy damage.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Watch for Reflective Sheen every forty-five seconds before casting into the master.
Damage shields are repeatedly removed from players on the hate list.
Pets on the hate list are hit by a heavy attack every three minutes.
Finish the master within the fifteen-minute trial.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
